title: Game Evening
description: Curated session lineups wrapping existing COSYgames titles into structured party night formats with seamless URL handoff.

lineups.title: ⚡ Quick Warm-Up & Icebreakers
lineups.description: High-energy, fast-paced games designed to break the ice and build confidence in conversational speaking.

games.name: Hot Seat
games.description: Rapid-fire vocabulary clues against the clock while sitting in the hot seat.

games.name: Action Hero
games.description: Hold your smartphone or word card up. Teammates describe secret target terms in the language while you guess as many as possible before time expires.

games.name: Emoji Odyssey
games.description: Decipher visual emoji sequences into idiomatic phrases and vocabulary.

games.name: 100 Questions
games.description: Speed-round conversation questions to get everyone talking freely.

lineups.title: 🧠 Trivia & Brain Teasers Night
lineups.description: Intellectual challenges, knowledge battles, and deduction puzzles for curious minds.

games.name: Battle of Wits
games.description: Two hot topics, two contrasting sides. Players are split into opposing camps to draft arguments, formulate debate strategies, and win the final ballot.

games.name: COSY Crossword
games.description: Collaborative crossword puzzle solving with clues in the target language.

games.name: Etymology Explorer
games.description: Trace word roots, cognates, and historical origins across languages.

games.name: Critics Corner
games.description: Spot subtle grammar errors and polish sentence structure as language critics.

lineups.title: 🎭 Improv & Storytelling Night
lineups.description: Creative narrative games that stretch imagination, roleplay skills, and fluent expression.

games.name: Identity Mystery
games.description: The host or player is secretly assigned a hidden persona or figure. Others take turns asking yes/no questions to decode the hidden identity in under 20 questions.

games.name: Story Chain
games.description: Build an unpredictable story together, one sentence at a time. Each player must secretly draw a target vocabulary word and weave it naturally into their turn.

games.name: Storytelling
games.description: Interactive narrative generator using plot twists, setting cards, and character motives.

games.name: Opinion Arena
games.description: Friendly debates and opinion sharing on controversial lighthearted topics.

lineups.title: 🎉 Vocab & Wordplay Party
lineups.description: Fun, accessible vocabulary games suitable for mixed-level groups and casual social gatherings.

games.name: Scene Match
games.description: Explore illustrated scenes and match target vocabulary terms to visual hotspots.

games.name: Word Linker
games.description: Test your vocabulary depth! Examine target words on screen, work together to spot the odd one out, and establish semantic connections.

games.name: Last Letter
games.description: Classic rapid word chain where each new word must begin with the final letter of the previous.

games.name: Lucky Numbers
games.description: Practice number recognition and spelling. The Caller synthesizes and speaks numbers/letters aloud in the target language while players complete their cards.
